title: Once the Pro lock is on, a gym that leaves Pro keeps its logo and colours everywhere except the member app
what: Logo and colours are a Pro feature. The member app and its home-screen shortcut drop a gym's look when the gym is not on Pro, but the gym's web page, the invite and join pages, the phone sign-in gym list, new branches and the top of the admin app keep showing the saved look. The owner also cannot open Branding to go back to MettleUp's look, because that whole page is closed for Starter, even though the server allows clearing it. The lock is off today, so nobody sees this yet.
expected: A gym without Pro shows MettleUp's look in the same way on every screen, and its owner can still remove the old look.
who: gyms that move from Pro to Starter
how_often: every time, once the Pro lock is turned on
fix_line: Make the shared brand answer empty for gyms without Pro, and keep the go-back-to-MettleUp's-look button open for them

title: Changing the logo or colours changes one branch only, and Branding does not say so
what: A new branch copies the first branch's look once. After that, saving on Branding changes only the branch that is open. An owner with several branches who uploads a new logo sees 'Saved. New members see it at once', but members of the other branches keep the old logo and colours, and nothing on the screen says the change was for this branch only.
expected: Branding says which branch it changes, or offers to use the same look in every branch of the business.
who: owners with more than one branch
how_often: every save in a multi-branch business
fix_line: Name the branch on Branding and add a choice to copy the look to all branches
